title: extract from closure
expected: Closures are never helpers; code pulled out of one into a method is an extract from the method around it.
old:
<?php
class Importer
{
    public function run(array $rows): array
    {
        return array_map(function (array $row) {
            $name = trim($row['name']);
            $email = strtolower(trim($row['email']));
            $joined = new \DateTimeImmutable($row['joined']);
            return ['name' => $name, 'email' => $email, 'joined' => $joined];
        }, $rows);
    }
}
new:
<?php
class Importer
{
    public function run(array $rows): array
    {
        return array_map(function (array $row) {
            return $this->normalise($row);
        }, $rows);
    }

    private function normalise(array $row): array
    {
        $name = trim($row['name']);
        $email = strtolower(trim($row['email']));
        $joined = new \DateTimeImmutable($row['joined']);
        return ['name' => $name, 'email' => $email, 'joined' => $joined];
    }
}

<?php
class Invoice
{
    public function total(): float
    {
        $sum = $this->subtotal();
        if ($this->discount > 0) {
            $sum -= $sum * $this->discount / 100;
        }
        return round($sum, 2);
    }

    {
        $sum = 0.0;
        foreach ($this->lines as $line) {
            $sum += $line->qty * $line->price;
        }
        return $sum;
    }
}

title: extract static
expected: Extract into a static method called with self:: (scoped_call_expression).
old:
<?php
final class Paths
{
    public static function join(string ...$parts): string
    {
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($parts as $p) {
            $p = trim($p, '/');
            if ($p !== '') {
                $clean[] = $p;
            }
        }
        return '/' . implode('/', $clean);
    }
}
new:
<?php
final class Paths
{
    public static function join(string ...$parts): string
    {
        return '/' . implode('/', self::clean($parts));
    }

    private static function clean(array $parts): array
    {
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($parts as $p) {
            $p = trim($p, '/');
            if ($p !== '') {
                $clean[] = $p;
            }
        }
        return $clean;
    }
}
